question: What of five lakshas, tenth-part homa, and rosary loci?
premises: these five lakshas declared, tenth part homa perform
in eyes, in going-coming, in mouth, in hamsa
inference: Five-laksha japa with tenth-part homa across eyes, mouth, course, hamsa, rosary.
plain_english: These five lakshas declared — perform tenth-part homa; in eyes, in going-coming, in mouth, in hamsa, and in aksa-rosary.
